title: BPM Playlist Builder for Spotify
description: A web app made for runners that lets Spotify users filter their playlists by tempo and create new playlists from matching songs.
statusNote: Spotify deprecated the API endpoints this project relied on — the app is no longer functional, but it was a blast to build.

title: AI Superbill Generator
description: A freelance project using AI/LLM technology to automatically generate medical superbills for a direct-pay dermatology clinic, reducing manual billing documentation time significantly.
statusNote: Currently in active development — screenshots coming soon.
